settings.heading: More access to care.
settings.copy: Helping make veterinary care more accessible for pets whose families face financial barriers.

settings.heading: Stronger pet communities.
settings.copy: Supporting nonprofit veterinary and animal-care organizations working to help animals in need.

settings.heading: Care for the caregivers.
settings.copy: Championing the well-being of veterinary professionals and the teams who care for our pets.

settings.heading: Spuds Has Heart.
settings.mission_copy: Spuds MacKenzie knows how to make people smile. Through the Spuds MacKenzie Pet Foundation, that fun has a purpose: helping pets get the care they need and supporting the people who care for them.
settings.values_copy: The Foundation focuses on pets, their communities, and the veterinary teams who care for them.
settings.closing_copy: There is a big heart behind those great shades. Get to know the Foundation and explore ways to help pets and the people who care for them.
